# NOW

> Next One Word — a free in-browser RSVP speed reader.

NOW shows one word at a time on a fixed point so you can read long text faster, with less eye travel. Paste something, set a pace, press Now.

- Site: https://now.fernaandojr.dev
- Reader: https://now.fernaandojr.dev/read
- Source: https://github.com/FernaandoJr/now
- License: MIT

## What it is

RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation). Each word lands on the same spot. Longer words and punctuation get a little more time. Speed is a number from 100 to 700. Portuguese and English. Text stays in this browser.

## Not for

Languages without spaces (CJK). Accounts, sync, or cloud storage.
